'''Maicombe''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Corthenia sector/Legends|Corthenia sector]]. In [[21 ABY/Legends|21 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] spent their second honeymoon on Maicombe.
